---
title: "Themes & Concepts"
---

Explore how computationally identified concepts move through the novel.
Select one or several concepts to compare their trajectories, associated
characters, chapters, and textual evidence.

<div class="bk-theme-toolbar">

<div>
<div class="bk-eyebrow">CONCEPT SELECTION</div>
<div id="bk-theme-pills" class="bk-theme-pills"></div>
</div>

<div class="bk-theme-actions">
<button id="bk-theme-clear" class="bk-button" type="button">
Clear
</button>
<button id="bk-theme-all" class="bk-button" type="button">
Select all
</button>
</div>

</div>

<div id="bk-theme-status" class="bk-theme-status"></div>

<div class="bk-theme-dashboard">

<section class="bk-theme-chart-panel">

<div class="bk-panel-heading">
<div>
<div class="bk-eyebrow">TRAJECTORY</div>
<h2>Concepts across the novel</h2>
</div>

<label>
<span>Measure</span>
<select id="bk-theme-measure">
<option value="passages">Passages mentioning concept</option>
<option value="matches">Total term matches</option>
</select>
</label>
</div>

<div id="bk-theme-chart"></div>

<p class="bk-panel-help">
The chart is truncated at your current reader position. Click a point
to inspect that chapter.
</p>

</section>

<aside id="bk-theme-detail" class="bk-theme-detail">

<div class="bk-detail-placeholder">
<div class="bk-eyebrow">CONCEPT INSPECTOR</div>
<h3>Select a concept</h3>
<p>
Choose a concept above to inspect its definition, chapter trajectory,
associated characters, and supporting passages.
</p>
</div>

</aside>

</div>

<section class="bk-theme-evidence-panel">

<div class="bk-panel-heading">
<div>
<div class="bk-eyebrow">TEXTUAL EVIDENCE</div>
<h2>Supporting passages</h2>
</div>

<div class="bk-theme-evidence-controls">

<label>
<span>Character</span>
<select id="bk-theme-character-filter">
<option value="">All characters</option>
</select>
</label>

<label>
<span>Chapter</span>
<select id="bk-theme-chapter-filter">
<option value="">All visible chapters</option>
</select>
</label>

</div>
</div>

<div id="bk-theme-evidence"></div>

</section>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/plotly.js-dist-min@3.1.0/plotly.min.js"></script>
